reports.title: Qualys Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

lines: Fourth Quarter 2026 Guidance: Management expects revenues for the fourth quarter of 2026 to be in the range of $191.0 million to $193.0 million, representing 9% to 10% growth over the same quarter in 2025.
Full Year 2026 Guidance: Management now expects revenues for the full year of 2026 to be in the range of $736.9 million to $738.9 million, representing 10% growth over 2025.

desk.headline: Revenue up 11% to $188.0m, beat; full-year revenue and EPS outlook raised
results: Revenue grew 11% to $188.0m, a little above the $186.6m analysts expected.
Adjusted EPS rose 14% to $2.12 (GAAP $1.62), beating the $1.96 estimate.
Adjusted EBITDA rose 9% to $89.9m; the margin eased to 48% from 49% as sales and marketing spend grew.
Billings grew 14% to $211.9m, helped by a strong federal quarter.
Operating cash flow rose 13% to $101.8m; $185.6m of shares were bought back in the first nine months.

guidance.summary: Qualys lifted its 2026 revenue range to about 10% growth and raised its full-year EPS ranges. It also set a Q4 revenue range of 9–10% growth.

points: Federal deals drove the billings beat; management warned that federal timing is lumpy and not a steady trend.
Partners now bring in 55% of revenue, with channel sales up 24% while direct sales fell 2%.
Customers are moving from trials to live use of the AI-based Risk Operations Center; newer modules are a growing share of bookings.
Q4 billings growth base case is about 8%; full-year free cash flow margin is guided in the low 40s.
No 2027 outlook yet; about $176m of buyback authority remained at quarter end.
call.source: Call transcript: Qualys (QLYS) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — The Motley Fool, 10 Nov 2026

watch: Billings growth in Q4 against the roughly 8% base case, after a federal-driven Q3.
Growth of the partner channel versus the shrinking direct business.
First 2027 outlook, due with Q4 results.
